name: Recommended
intent: Best-case general profile: maximize image quality while staying within the useful 4K ceiling of a standard PS5.

technical_basis.source_reference: Nintendo Switch 1 docked output up to 1920x1080 at 60 Hz
technical_basis.target_reference: Standard PS5: Zen 2 8c/16t, RDNA 2-class GPU, 16 GB GDDR6
reasoning: For a 1080p-class Switch render, 2.0x produces 3840x2160 internally, exactly matching 4K output.
2.0x is the practical useful ceiling for 4K output; 3.0x and 4.0x render substantially beyond the display resolution and mostly add supersampling cost.
Bilinear avoids unnecessary reconstruction when internal resolution already reaches the output target.
No global post-process AA is forced because 2.0x internal rendering already reduces edge aliasing and many Switch games implement their own AA.
60 Hz cleanly presents both native 30 FPS and 60 FPS Switch titles without changing game timing.
